title: Canonical additive derived-stalk comparison for open restriction
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], an open U of X and z in U.toScheme, with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], define the natural isomorphism from exact derived open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] followed by derived stalk cohomology at z [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport] and forgetting the stalk module scalars, to derived stalk cohomology on X at z.val followed by forgetting scalars. It is the isomorphism obtained from overFunctorEquiv, restrictStalkNatIso, exact localization composition, and commutation of exact additive forgetful functors with cohomology.

def openDerivedAdditiveStalkIso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (z : U.toScheme) (i : ℤ) :
    (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        comparisonStalkCohomology U.toScheme z i ⋙
          forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
      comparisonStalkCohomology X z.val i ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk z.val)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
